cases.title: K-9 Saxon: Oxyglobin, survival and the legacy of the Saxon Award
cases.summary: Fresno Police K-9 Saxon survived catastrophic line-of-duty injuries after being shot at point-blank range. In a letter reproduced in Biopure's 2002 Annual Report, Fresno Police Chief Jerry Dyer described Oxyglobin as playing a pivotal role in Saxon's survival. Fresno Police later established the Saxon Award in his honor.
cases.sourceBoundary: Historical company-published case account supported by an official Fresno Police legacy record; not a controlled clinical trial and not evidence of BHOC efficacy.

cases.title: Wodan: critical veterinary care, oxygen-carrying support and recovery
cases.summary: Bellwether No. 49 documented Wodan, a five-year-old Belgian Malinois police dog transferred to Penn Vet's VHUP after severe line-of-duty trauma. Oxyglobin was recorded as one component of a broader intensive-care and surgical strategy.
cases.sourceBoundary: Historical single-case narrative from a university veterinary publication; documents treatment context and Oxyglobin use but does not establish causality or BHOC efficacy.
